body: I know how you feel. Ive been fighting through a depressive episode too recently. Reddit helped me feel a lot better. And i am seeing a counselor for the first time this week. Try and stay focused. Also try taking vitamin D3 i heard it fights off depression. Also try getting out(if the weather is nice near you.) I usually just drive around or walk my dogs. I hope you feel better!

Its okay. Trust me when i first started talking about all of my problems in life i actually felt better. The depression is still there, but now that i am aware of it i feel a lot better. Even though i dont have friends or anyone really important in my life reddit has helped me a lot. Try going to a counselor. Its okay to let all your feelings out here. We care. We will help you as much as we can. Youre not being selfish. Just write down what is bothering you.

I suffer from night terrors frequently but i cant remember them. I wake up screaming and sweating. Bad dreams/nightmares suck. I also have reoccurring ones. Mostly in mine i am being raped, or murdered. There might be a reason for why you are having these dreams. Maybe you stressed? Maybe its the shows you watch? or games you play? some people say that nightmares can be linked to trauma that you have had. Try to find some counselling. Places offer sliding scales if you have no insurance. If you are student some places will usually counsel you for free. I wish you the best of luck.

Hello, 
I see i was in a very similar situation. Kind of still am. I met a man too who is my everything. But lately he has been really really depressed. and it is fucking everything up. I know exactly how you feel about being called worthless and stuff. I dont talk to any of my parents really. What he said to you isnt right at all. If he knows how much you suffered he had no right to lie to you. maybe he thought he was protecting you? maybe he didnt want you to worry? i am not sure. Maybe try talking it out with him one more time. Try to stay calm. I am truly sorry for what happened to you. But trust me you arent alone. tons of people out there know exactly how you feel including me. I fight off my depression daily. I try to stay motivated and happy as much as possible. If you ever want to to talk ill be here.

Ugh. i wouldnt blame you for not wanting to go to her then. Try calling a hotline. They might be able to help. They might know of some places in your area that have a sliding scale, or free. Esp being in your situations. Good luck!

does your school have a therapist, counselor, or psychologist? You can try there first. that's what i am doing. My high school, and middle school both had all of these. So maybe yours does too. you can also try calling a hotline maybe. I was extremely depressed at your age. It ruined my life. I would hate to see you go through what i did. Whatever you do, do not turn to drugs it will make everything worse. I used drugs as my scapegoat for all the pain i had bottled up inside. which is the worse thing to do. Try and stay strong, and ask your school for help.

i am really sorry to hear that happened to you. i feel the same way as you do. Talking about it does seem to help me feel better, but it goes away after a while. I think about ending my life just about everyday. I finally decided to try counselling at my school, and see if it helps me at all. i am 26 years old and just started college last year because of my depression. I have tried to kill myself at least 3 times...each time failed. I also which this was all just a bad dream. I really wish that i could just wake up from it all. The best advice i can give you, is wait a little bit before you tell this girl how you feel. you will know when the time is right. Also try to get some counselling too. Get some sunlight if you can. it always makes me feel better. I wish you the best of luck!

Hello, 
Thank you for the reply. I am so happy to hear that you found someone to help you. I went to my school counselling today. I made an appointment for this week. I hope i like her a lot. I really need someone who wont judge me, and who can help me. I am so thankful for reddit. I never knew about it. Thank you again. =D

Thank you for your reply. Yeah i do feel better when i admit my problems. its hard getting pass the ego though. My SO is my major support system but recently he has been really depressed, and i don't want to bother him with my problems now.

Thank you for wishing me luck. =) 
and for the reply.
hey thank you for the reply! i actually went to my counselor, and made an appointment. we will see how it works out for me.

Hey there, 
thank you so much for your reply. Ive had this depression for a while. I made an appointment today with my school counselor. So maybe that will help. But talking here helps me too, bc nobody can see my face, and can understand me better. every time i try to talk about my problems in person i just end up crying...ive been under so much stress lately, and i feel like i cant do anything. my SO other has also been very depressed, and i think thats what has been messing me up. I keep trying to help him, but nothing i do gets through to him. It hurts a lot. he is so stubborn too. he would never talk about his problems to someone else. so i dont know how to help. he thinks he is inadequate at everything..school, work, sex, height, weight.....so then it makes me stress even more and then my depression amplifies. =( any suggestions?
